title: Normalized quota snapshot
description: The §6 normalized quota contract every subgov source (native or generic) must emit. Mirrors QuotaSnapshot/QuotaWindow in src/model.rs and the extra checks in validate_snapshot() (src/source.rs). additionalProperties is left open everywhere because the Rust structs do not use #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] -- an unrecognized field is ignored, not rejected, and this schema must not be stricter than the deserializer it documents. Non-finite numbers (NaN/Infinity) cannot appear here at all: JSON's own number grammar has no token for them, so 'finite' is enforced by using JSON at all, not by a schema keyword.

observed_at.description: When the provider data was obtained, not when the controller happens to read a cache. RFC 3339. The pattern backstops 'format' for validators that treat format as annotation-only.

fresh.description: The source's own freshness judgment. Optional -- missing defaults to true, matching #[serde(default = "default_true")] on QuotaSnapshot::fresh. The controller separately enforces its own configured maximum age.

eligible_backlog_capacity.description: Optional count of workers supported by eligible queued work. Banked-reset pacing is capped at this count; when absent, the current worker count is the cap.

windows.description: Every active consumption limit relevant to the account. An empty array is invalid, not unlimited capacity (§6.1). `id` must be unique within this array (§6.2); JSON Schema has no portable keyword for uniqueness of a single property across array items, so this constraint is documented here but not mechanically enforced by this schema -- verify it separately (subgov-bbe7889c tracks the matching gap in validate_snapshot()).

id.description: Stable within one source and account; need not be globally unique. Empty string is rejected the same way validate_snapshot() rejects it.

used_fraction.description: Finite and inclusive in [0, 1], checked by validate_snapshot().

resets_at.description: Absolute UTC timestamp, RFC 3339. Missing or unparsable fails the snapshot.

duration_minutes.description: Optional metadata; pacing depends on resets_at, not this field.

reached.description: Explicit provider signal. The controller also treats used_fraction >= target as binding.

resetCreditsSnapshot.description: Earned, one-shot rate-limit resets attached to an account. available_count is authoritative; a caller must not infer the total balance from the number of `credits` detail rows.

id.description: Rejected when empty after trimming, matching validate_snapshot()'s credit.id.trim().is_empty() check -- the pattern requires at least one non-whitespace character.
